study type: Observational cohort study using a causal inference approach
outcome: Mean Expanded Disease Status Scale (EDSS) score
cohort: Female patients with multiple sclerosis (MS) aged 18-45 years at MS onset, clinically followed up for more than 2 years, and with at least 3 Expanded Disease Status Scale (EDSS) measurements.
finding: Pregnancy had no significant long-term causal effect on the mean EDSS score at 9 years or on the annual probability of relapse in patients with multiple sclerosis.
followup_time: 9 years after pregnancy for long-term effects, with a median follow-up duration of 7.8 years for the cohort.
